reason: Based on the repository description and README, the plugin is primarily a smart form/list utility for users to record and organize structured data via conversation, with helper functions for attachments, auto classification, periodic summaries, and reminders, so it is best classified under data processing rather than development or search-oriented tooling.

summaries.zh: ListForm 是一款基于对话触发的智能表单技能，用于记录支出、出货和运行日志等结构化信息，并可附带附件、自动分类、生成周期报表和提醒。
summaries.en: ListForm is a conversation-triggered smart form skill for recording structured items like expenses, shipment logs, and operational notes, with attachment support, auto classification, periodic reports, and reminders.

capabilities: supports structured record creation for expenses, shipment logs, and operational notes
supports attaching images and documents to records
supports automatic classification and custom categorization rules
supports periodic reporting for daily/weekly/monthly summaries
supports scheduled reminders for due dates and custom cycles

reasons.code: The plugin captures and stores user financial and inventory-related entries, which may include sensitive operational data.
Attachment support for images and documents can increase data sensitivity and retention scope of user files.
Reminder and anomaly-notification features can trigger user actions based on budget or stock thresholds, creating scheduling and decision implications.
